titleStmt.title: Mahābhārata Āraṇyakaparvan with the commentary of Nīlakaṇṭha

msContents.summary: A manuscript of the Āraṇyakaparvan with commentary.

lg.l: jalāṃ copajalāṃ caiva yamunām abhito nadīṃ ||

uśīnarā vai ya
treṣṭvā vāsavād atyaricyuta ||
tāṃ devasamitiṃ tasya vāsavaś ca viśāṃ pate ||
abhyagachan nṛpavaraṃ jñātum agniś ca bhārata ||
jijñāsamānau varadau mahātmānam uśīnaraṃ ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā yajñe bhijagmatuḥ || 23 ||

urū rājñaḥ samāsādya ka
pota śyenajad bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī tadā rāja nililye bhayapīḍitaḥ || 24 ||
dharmātmānaṃ tv ādur ekaṃ sarve rājan_ mahīkṣitaḥ ||
sa vai dharmaviruddhaṃ tvaṃ kasmāt karma cikīrṣasi | 1 |

vihitaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ
rājan_ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||
mā rakṣīr dharmalobhena dharmam utsṛṣṭavāsina 2

maṃtrasvarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto
bhīto mahādvija ||
praspaṃdamānaḥ saṃbhrāṃtaḥ kapotaḥ śyena lakṣyate 3
matsakāśe jīvitārthatisya tyāgo vivarjitaḥ ||

yo hi
kaści dvijān hanyād gā vā lokasya mātaraṃ 4
śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyajate tulyaṃ teṣāṃ hi pātakaṃ

āhārāt sarva
bhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti mahīpate ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jantavaḥ || 6 ||

śakyate dustyaje py arthe cirarātrāya jīvi
tuṃ ||
na tu bhojanam utsṛjya śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciraṃ 7
bhakṣād viyojitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||

visṛjya kāyam eṣyaṃ
ti paṃthānam akuto bhayaṃ || 8 ||
pramṛte mayi dharmātman_ putradāradinaṃ kṣyati ||

rakṣamānaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān_ rakṣasī
9
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ kudharma tat ||
avirodhā tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ satyavikrama || 10 ||

virodhiṣu mahīpāla
niścitya gurulāghavaṃ ||
na bādhā vidyate yatra taṃ dharma samupācaret || 11 ||
gurulāghavam adāya dharmātmādharmaviniścaye ||

yato
bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuruṣv adharmaniścayaṃ || 12 ||
bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama ||

suparṇaḥ pakṣirā
ṭ_ kiṃ tvaṃ dharmaṃjñaś cāsyasaṃśayaṃ || 13 ||
tathā hi dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu citraṃ ca bhāṣase ||

na te sty aviditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayā
my ahaṃ || 14 ||
śaraṇeṣi parityāgaṃ kathaṃ sādhv iti manyase ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama 25

śakyaś cāpy anyathā karttum āhāro py adhika
s tvayā ||
govṛṣo vā varāho vā mṛgo vā mahiṣo pi vā 16
tvadartham adya kriyatāṃ yac cānyad iha kākṣasi

na varāhaṃ na
cokṣāṇan na mṛgān_ vividhāṃs tathā
bhakṣayāmi mahāṃ rāja kim mamānye na kenacit ||

yas tu me devavihito bhakṣyaḥ kṣatriyapuṃgava ||
18
tam utsṛja mahīpāla kapotam imam eva me ||
śyenaḥ kapotān ajīti schitir eṣā sanātanī ||

mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃ
dham āsaja 19
rāṣṭraṃ śivīnām ṛdhaṃ vai dadāni tava khecara ||
yaṃ vā kaāmayase kāmaṃ śyena sarvaṃ dadāni te || 20 ||

vinemaṃ pa
kṣiṇaṃ śyena śaraṇārthinam āgataṃ
yenemaṃ varjayethās tvaṃ karmaṇā pakṣisattama ||
tadācakṣva kariṣyāmi na didāsye kapotakaṃ 21
uśīnara kapote te yadi sneho narādhipa
ātmano māṃsam utkṛtya kapotaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ 22

yadā samaṃ kapotena tava māṃ
saṃ nṛpottama ||
tadā deyaṃ tu tan mahyaṃ sā me tuṣṭir bhaviṣyati ||
anugraham imaṃ manye śyena yan mābhiyācase |

tasmāt te dya pra
dāsyāmi stvamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ || 24 ||
utkṛtya svayaṃ māṃsaṃ rājā paramadharmavit ||

tulayāmāsa kauṃteya kapotena
samaṃ vibho || 25 ||
dhriyamāṇaḥ kapotas tu māṃsenāny atiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni rājā prādād uśīnaraḥ 26

na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ dhṛ
taṃ |
tata utkṛtyamāṃso sāv āruroha svayaṃ tulāṃ 27
iṃdro ham asmi dharmajña kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ ||

jijñāsamānau dharmaṃ tvāṃ ya
jñavāṭam upāgatau ||
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhya utkṛtāni viśāṃ pate ||
eṣā te bhāsvatī kīrttir lokān abhibhaviṣyati || 28 ||

yāval loke ma
nuṣyās tvāṃ kathayiṣyaṃti pārthiva ||
tāvāat kīrttiś ca lokāś ca sthāsyaṃti tava śāśvatāḥ || 29 ||
ity evam utkā rājānam āruroha divaṃ gunaḥ ||
uśīnaro pi dharmānmā dharmeṇāvṛtya rodasī 30
vibhrājamāno vapuṣāpr āruroha triviṣṭapaṃ ||

tad etat_ sadanaṃ rājan_ rājñas tasya
mahātmanaḥ || 31 ||
paśyaś caitan mayā sārdhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapramocanaṃ ||
tatraiva satataṃ devā munayaś ca sanātanāḥ || 32 ||

dṛśyaṃte brāhmaṇai rāja
n_ puṇyavadbhir mmahātmabhiḥ ||
